How it's made

  1. We select kiln-dried hardwoods from local suppliers.
  2. Boards are glued, planed, and sanded to a smooth finish.
  3. Each board is finished with food-safe mineral oil & beeswax.
  4. Optional laser or hand-engraving available.
  5. Care kit included with every order.

About Double Cut

We’re two seniors in high school who turned a love of shop class into a small business. We believe useful things can also be beautiful, and we put that into every board we make.

Your purchase supports our college savings and helps us keep building (literally!). Thank you for shopping local.

Care Guide

Hand-wash with mild soap, dry upright. Re-oil monthly with food-safe mineral oil. Avoid dishwasher and soaking.

Refunds

30-day returns on unused items. Custom engravings are final sale. Contact us for help.
